description:
Temida keeps your litigation prep organized in one place. Track case facts, witnesses, legal grounds, damages scenarios, lawyer contacts, deadlines, and call scripts — all synced securely across devices.

Built for self-represented litigants and anyone managing their own legal matter:

• Case tab — facts, witnesses, grounds, and a running case journal
• Money tab — damages scenarios and settlement frameworks
• Actions tab — lawyer directory, timeline, checklists, and phone/email scripts
• Face ID lock keeps your case data private
• Sign in with Apple or email — your data is isolated to your account
• Export briefs to PDF

Your case content is stored securely and never shared. No ads, no tracking.
promotionalText: Organize your case. Know your next step.
